title: Normal map from a height field
purpose: Turn a Float32Array height field into tangent-space normals and an RGBA8 normal map by central differences, with a strength, wrapped or clamped edges and the OpenGL or DirectX green convention, and wrap it as a three.js DataTexture for normalMap. Use it to add relief to procedural surfaces without a baking tool.

engine.name: webgl2_browser
engine.notes: normalsFromHeight and normalMapFromHeight need no three.js; createNormalMapTexture takes three.js r152 or later as THREE (colorSpace); only 0.186.1 was run.

exports.name: normalsFromHeight
exports.summary: Unit tangent-space normals, xyz per texel, row 0 at v = 0.

exports.name: normalMapFromHeight
exports.summary: The RGBA8 normal map of the same normals.

exports.name: encodeNormal
exports.signature: encodeNormal(x, y, z, convention = 'opengl') -> [r, g, b, a]
exports.summary: Bytes of one unit normal: round((c / 2 + 0.5) * 255); DirectX flips green.

exports.name: createNormalMapTexture
exports.signature: createNormalMapTexture(THREE, rgba, width, height, options = {}) -> THREE.DataTexture
exports.summary: Linear (NoColorSpace) DataTexture with repeat or clamp wrapping and mipmaps.

exports.name: NORMAL_MAP_DEFAULTS
exports.summary: Frozen default options: strength 1, edges wrap, convention opengl.

options.name: strength
options.meaning: Multiplies the slopes (height units per texel) before normalizing.

options.name: edges
options.meaning: How differences read past the border: tiling wraps, a single decal clamps.

options.name: convention
options.meaning: Green up (OpenGL, three.js, glTF) or green down (DirectX).

limits: Central differences over one texel: fine detail smaller than two texels is lost and steep steps alias; there is no Sobel or multi-scale filter and no height-to-world scale beyond strength. Normals are encoded in 8 bits, so each component is within about 0.004 of the exact value. The tangent frame is the texture's own (u right, v up); a mesh with mirrored or rotated UVs needs matching tangents. createNormalMapTexture builds an RGBA texture (no two-channel or compressed formats). Only three.js 0.186.1 was run, in headless Chrome on SwiftShader WebGL 2.
technique_references: Tangent-space normal n = normalize(-s dh/du, -s dh/dv, 1)
